summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that automatically fires on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip` into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. The target `math_init.js` is a ~728 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` file shipped at the tarball root with rotated-string-array obfuscation (a `WV8StW(a,b,c)` shifter over a multi-thousand-entry mixed constant array). The obfuscated payload is executed only by the fetched alternate runtime and is not reachable via normal Node module resolution or referenced by the React widget code under `dist/`. Using a separately downloaded runtime to execute an opaque sibling script at install time is not part of the package's stated purpose as a marketing-widgets library, and no unminified source for the executed payload is included.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
